about.heading: About
about.bio: I'm a backend software engineer based in Mumbai, India. I build and ship production systems across the Python ecosystem, from high concurrency AsyncIO pipelines to FastAPI microservices and AI/LLM integrations.
paragraphs: At Homeville Group I work on AI microservices, LLM integration, and Python ecosystem projects under the VP of Technology. I have rebuilt loan processing pipelines, shipped Tier-1 bank integrations, and modernized OCR and reconciliation systems.
My work was recognized at the Global Fintech Festival 2025. I care about systems that stay fast and correct under real traffic, enterprise constraints, and messy data.
